products.name: Chroma
products.note: Open-source embedding database; local-first; lightweight RAG; self-hosted option

profile_text.body:
Chroma is an open-source search infrastructure company for AI, operating under an Apache 2.0 license. The company describes itself as bringing security, compliance, education, and operational capabilities suited to enterprise needs through that open-source architecture. Its website is trychroma.com.

The company's primary product, also called Chroma, is an open-source embedding database designed for local-first use, lightweight retrieval-augmented generation workflows, and self-hosted deployments. It is categorized as a coding and developer tool. No litigation, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent records are held for the company at this time.
